created_entries.body: For award-recipient tables, extract names, award years, award-time affiliations and individual prize motivations from official award announcements. Preserve distinct motivations for split awards. Keep unsupported fields explicitly unresolved. Build targeted biography searches only for missing fields and group related entities for schema-validated extraction, retaining each source URL and original fetched text. Nationality requires an explicit nationality or citizenship statement; birthplace, ancestry, residence and institutional location are not substitutes. Preserve supported multiple nationalities and the source's regional or historical qualifications. Do not silently convert a historical state designation into present citizenship. Validate each nonempty quote as an exact contiguous substring of every source cited for that quote, then separately verify that the passage supports the complete value for the correct person and requested time. Exact membership alone does not establish semantic support. Use supplementary biographies only for the missing field rather than replacing already supported award facts. Merge verified cells into the existing rows and retain unresolved cases for focused follow-up.
